blocks.translation:
• The target age for this product is 15 years and older.
• Do not give it to children under the target age under any circumstances.
• This product contains small parts and batteries; take care that small children do not accidentally swallow them.
• There is a risk of choking and similar hazards.
• Do not use it near the ear. If used incorrectly, there is a risk of hearing damage.
• This product uses electronic components; people with pacemakers should exercise caution.
• Do not put fingers or the like into gaps in moving parts. There is a risk of injury from being pinched.
• Do not play roughly, such as by hitting or swinging it around.
• Do not stare at the flashing LED light. It may cause you to feel unwell.
• Improper use of batteries may cause heating, explosion, or leakage. Please observe the following precautions.
• If battery leakage gets into the eyes, immediately rinse with plenty of water and consult a physician.
• If leaked liquid gets on the skin or clothing, wash with water.
• Button batteries are dangerous if swallowed. Store them out of reach of children.
• Do not mix old and new batteries or different types of batteries for use.
• Set the + and − (polarity) correctly.
• Do not short-circuit, charge, disassemble, heat, or throw into fire.
• When disposing of batteries, follow your municipality's disposal instructions.

• This product is manufactured with precision. Do not apply excessive force or drop it, as it may be damaged. This product is made up of precision electronic components. Do not drop it, get it wet, soil it, or disassemble it. Also avoid using or storing it in places that become high or low in temperature.
• Do not place this product on resin (plastic) sofas, seats, tiles, or similar surfaces. Prolonged contact may cause color transfer.
